original_test_intent: Establish that the target AMD GPU/driver is supported by the approved ROCm DCT stack and that an authorized DCT control capability works and restores cleanly.
original_method: Build immutable compatible ROCm/DCT artifacts, prove inventory/telemetry compatibility first, then execute exactly one owner-approved low-impact control/readback/restore transaction with baseline, bounded value, independent health monitoring and rollback evidence.
manual_activity: GPU controls owner selects the safe DCT capability/value and restoration contract, authorizes critical execution and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Exact DCT API/CLI control property and stable GPU selector
safety_requirements: Start with read-only discovery and health baseline
Use the least-impact owner-approved property only
Bound the value and dwell and preserve independent OOB
Always restore and verify baseline; no automatic retry or alternate control
agent_execution_scope: Verify immutable build and supported target
Perform only the explicitly approved transactional probe
Restore/report evidence without choosing property/value or final verdict
engineer_actions: Define control semantics and safe transaction
Review restoration and health and decide outcome

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `rocm-smi` inventory is a different tool and read-only observation, so it cannot prove DCT control suitability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After explicit approval, use pinned DCT to pre-read, set one bounded reversible property, read back, restore and verify while monitoring health and audit state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ROCm plus DCT build and GPU-control intent are retained; no unspecified control command is guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Separate discovery/support evidence from one transactional control probe with stable target identity and mandatory restore verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns undefined 'can control' into an auditable reversible capability without broadening authority.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only rocm-smi output proves neither DCT installation nor mutation/readback/restore.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some GPUs expose only selected DCT controls; unsupported properties require engineering disposition, not substitution.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must name the authoritative DCT/RDC revision and the exact lowest-risk control capability that satisfies this platform's intent.
expected_evidence: Pinned build BOM/checksums/versions and support matrix
Stable GPU identity and DCT capability enumeration
Cleanup/recovery, anomaly dispositions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and criteria consistently target DCT control, but the exact control capability is underdefined.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row211 Wistron-AMD GPU-00204-V002: approve the authoritative pinned ROCm DCT/RDC revision and a single lowest-risk reversible GPU control property with stable target selector, baseline/test value, tolerance, dwell, readback/restore, privilege/audit, thermal/power/error abort and OOB recovery contract. Read-only rocm-smi output must not count as DCT control PASS.

review_improvement: Defines DCT suitability as a support proof plus one explicitly approved transactional control/restore operation rather than a different tool's inventory output.
independent_technical_reasoning: A management stack can enumerate a GPU yet lack permission or firmware support for writes, so discovery does not establish control. Conversely, choosing a clock, power or fan write without platform authority could destabilize the DUT. The minimal valid proof is an owner-selected low-impact property with stable identity, bounded value, readback and mandatory verified restoration under independent observation.
